about_the_game:
Key Features:

  • First-Person Psychological Horror: Immerse yourself in a terrifying dreamworld that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

  • Singleplayer Narrative: Unravel a deep and engaging story as you progress through the game, discovering the truth about Lunatix and your role in their experiments.

  • Interactive Puzzle Levels: Solve creative and challenging puzzles that require you to manipulate your environment to progress.

  • Atmospheric Terror: Experience a rich and immersive world designed to unsettle and disorient, with dynamic environments and eerie sound design.

Can you escape the clutches of Lunatix and wake up from this endless nightmare? Find out in this gripping and unforgettable horror adventure.

content_descriptors.notes: Some of  the levels have bloody scenes and dead bodies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 770 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 280 3GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-4770K / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Enter the twisted dreamworld of Lunatix in this first-person psychological horror experience. As a test subject you'll navigate a distorted and ever-changing landscape, where reality blurs with nightmare. Solve interactive puzzles to unravel the mysteries of your subconscious and the forces at play.
